View 2406 8th Ave W V6K 2B1 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 2 bed, 1 bath, 1350 Sq. Ft. apartment. 2406 8th Ave W is currently on market.
ZMP93075822 - Welcome to this BEAUTIFULLY RENOVATED Half duplex in trendy Kitsilano. This corner property of 5,750 square feet has tons of outdoor space for gardening and lounging. Conveniently located in walking distance to transportation, schools (3 blocks). shopping, dining and the beaches. Bright & spacious open living space of approx 1,350 Sq feet. Windows facing east, west, south and north. Boasting a BRAND NEW kitchen which comes with Quartz countertops, soft closing wooden drawers in kitchen, stainless steel appliances which include stove, dishwasher and fridge. Tons of counter space and storage for the gourmet chef. BRAND NEW bathroom comes with shower, bathtub, toilet, over height, ergonomically designed double vanity sinks with quartz countertops, (no more bending over to brush your teeth!!). Gigantic living room could even accommodate a grand piano. Laundry room has BRAND NEW full size washer/dryer & laundry tub. Brand new Oak vinyl plank floors, ceramic tiles, and original oak hardwood floors with inlay throughout. Entire home has been freshly painted, and all new energy efficient lighting throughout. 2 large bedrooms are completely separated for privacy. Covered outdoor patio and access to gardens for lounging and gardening. Lots of free street parking. Absolutely, NON smoking! Available immediately. 2 Cats Allowed - 50% of one month\'s rent required for pet deposit. Utilities not included in base rent price.
